anomalies.description: A motorcycle on the right shoulder loses traction on snow, slides sideways, and falls over, with the rider separating from the vehicle and coming to rest in the snowbank.

A vehicle on the left (likely a dark SUV or sedan) collides with the dashcam vehicle, producing a bright blue-white flash and visible impact distortion at frame f5 (26.5s), followed by smoke/vapor and displacement in frames f6–f7 (27.0–27.5s).
A white SUV loses control, swerves sharply left across the lane divider, and appears to collide or nearly collide with the recording vehicle, causing a sudden camera shake and spray of water/slush.

A white SUV on the right side of the road suddenly swerves left and collides with the dashcam vehicle, causing a visible impact and spray of water/debris; the SUV then veers sharply right off the road.

Vehicle experiences sudden violent impact or loss of control, resulting in extreme camera shake and streaking light trails; scene becomes completely blurred and disoriented, consistent with a crash or rollover.
